The partial reference to the alarm object for present value.

This property controls the font that all the tooltips will appear in. You must type the font exactly correct for the tooltips to work. Remember that each client machine must have the font as well. There is no auto-download of fonts.

Enter the name of the local variable that contains the network portion of the object reference that this shape is to bind to. Enter <none> if you do not wish to use a network alias. If set, the bound reference is the concatenation of the value of network alias variable, the value of the system alias variable (if set) and the object reference property.

Enter the name of the local variable that contains the system portion of the object reference that shapes on the page are to bind to. Enter <none> if you do not wish to use a system alias. If set, the bound reference is the concatenation of the value of network alias variable, the value of the system alias variable (if set) and the object reference property
Controls whether the tooltips display the (calculated) object reference.

v:ud.v:val: VT4(SVG <script><![CDATA[function fixtext(target) {var tb = target;var bb = tb.getBBox();var children = tb.getChildNodes();for (child_idx=0; child_idx < children.length; child_idx++){if (children.item(child_idx).nodeName() == 'text'){var thetext = children.item(child_idx);textchildren = thetext.getChildNodes;for(textchild_idx=0; textchildren.length; textchild_idx++){if (textchildren.item(textchild_idx).nodeName() == 'v:paragraph'){switch(textchildren.item(textchild_idx).getAttribute('v:horizAlign')){case '1': var text_start = parseFloat(thetext.getAttribute('x'));var text_width = thetext.getComputedTextLength();text_start += text_width / 2;thetext.setAttribute('x', text_start);thetext.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');break;case '2': var text_width = thetext.getComputedTextLength();var text_start = parseFloat(thetext.getAttribute('x'));text_start += text_width;thetext.setAttribute('x', text_start);thetext.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'end');break;default: break;}break;}}break;}}}]]></script>)
